observed.stage: wrapper-only final replay after Link-75 artifact completion

cause.mechanism: The inherited Link-75 link action had already configured the order-sensitive Prim-67 then Prim-68 profile geometry in-process. The wrapper invoked the same configurator again before its final read-only replay.
cause.fix: Reuse the configured state immediately after a completed link action; initialize it once only when resuming the final replay in a fresh process.

first_red_rule: No WPLTO, product link, or artifact completion is repeated. Only the read-only final gate replay resumes.
claim_limit: Checker lifecycle stop only; no product or hardware claim.
